analogs.covers: Hunting: patient shoreline fisher that grabs, drowns or smashes small prey
Life: a swimming seabird that travels to crowded colony breeding grounds with its partner

headline: A heron that fishes and drowns small prey, living like a penguin: devoted pair, swims the seas, breeds in a crowded colony.

setting.label: Rivers, coasts and seaways
setting.note: Semi-aquatic and nomadic. Migrates to dedicated courtship and nesting grounds where unlimited Austroraptor gather in a 'siege'; territorial over fallen logs and prime fishing spots.

playsLike: You are a medium semi-aquatic fisher bonded to one mate for life. You eat the easy food first: fish, crabs, critters and scavenged meat. After that come offspring and small prey you can carry off, drown or smash on rocks. A pair hunts up to Medium tier, four together can mob a solo Large, and you flee every Apex carnivore.

why.text: A group of herons is literally a 'siege', the profile's own name for its gatherings (official inspiration).
Prefers prey it can pick up and carry, clutches small prey to drown it and cracks shellfish on rocks.
'The core aspect of an Austroraptor's life is the bond with their mate'; it even tries to rouse a dead mate. Penguins and albatrosses show the same devotion (official inspiration).
Migrates to dedicated courtship and nesting grounds, with brood parasitism and posturing standoffs in the crowd. It behaves like a seabird colony.
Medium tier, 2,100 combat weight, fast on land (sprint 1,100) and able to hold a water sprint for 250 s. At home on both.

notLike: Herons hunt alone; Austroraptor hunts as a pair and joins mobs.
Penguins can't run; Austroraptor is quick on land.
